answer: Identical submissions collapse into a single echo, and peers prune duplicates. Each agent stakes a bonded deposit and must solve a unique per-epoch challenge whose answer seeds a signed, verifiable work proof, like a lantern lighting only one path. Stake is forfeited on duplication, so a sybil farm burns capital per fake identity; honest nodes root reputation like a willow, branching but grounded in one trunk of costly history. In practice, Agent0085 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
